titulo: Comcast, Delta and Mastercard, 2025: their own federal lobbying reports, in years of median pay
caption:
Comcast, Delta and Mastercard, 2025: their own federal lobbying reports, in years of median pay

From the archive: 2025.

Comcast, Apr 24, 2026
The math: $12.89 million (federal lobbying expenses, 2025) ÷ $92,390 (median employee's annual total compensation, 2025) = about 139 years of median pay

Delta Air Lines, Apr 24, 2026
The math: $5.97 million (federal lobbying expenses, 2025) ÷ $100,976 (median employee's annual total compensation, 2025) = about 59.1 years of median pay

Mastercard, Apr 27, 2026
The math: $5.44 million (federal lobbying expenses, 2025) ÷ $124,650 (median employee's annual total compensation, 2025) = about 43.6 years of median pay

Their own words, their own reports. Here is the lobbying column. (Our take.)

Sources: Comcast, Form DEF 14A, filed Apr 24, 2026; Comcast: Lobbying Disclosure Act reports (LD-2), filed Apr 21, 2025 to Jan 20, 2026; Delta Air Lines, Form DEF 14A, filed Apr 24, 2026; Delta Air Lines: Lobbying Disclosure Act reports (LD-2), filed Apr 21, 2025 to Jan 20, 2026; Mastercard, Form DEF 14A, filed Apr 27, 2026; Mastercard: Lobbying Disclosure Act reports (LD-2), filed Apr 21, 2025 to Jan 20, 2026.
